name: hanshi
description: A blog theme: hairline frames, generated pattern covers, a page ruler for pagination and an index that follows you through every post.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: Brand uses the colour from Theme > Colours and fonts. The others are presets with their own dark-mode pair.

color_mode.title: Colour mode
color_mode.description: What a first-time visitor sees. Visitors can still switch with the header toggle.

home_sections.title: Show the homepage's own sections
home_sections.description: Render the sections of the page set as the homepage below the posts.

covers.title: Covers
covers.description: auto draws a pattern cover for posts without a featured image.

subscribe_url.title: Newsletter address
subscribe_url.description: Adds an Email link and a Subscribe button. Empty shows feeds only.

visitor_panel.title: Let visitors try the presets
visitor_panel.description: Shows a small Theme panel with the accent, font, spacing and corner presets, saved in the visitor's browser. Meant for demo sites.
